explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/639: in a 2-colouring of K_n, are at most n²/4 edges outside every monochromatic triangle? An edge {x,y} of K_n counts as uncovered if no third vertex z gives a monochromatic triangle with it. Colourings are maps Sym2 (Fin n) → Fin 2, and the diagonal values are irrelevant. The statement asserts the ⌊n²/4⌋ bound for all large n, the reading in which it is true (it fails at n = 6), as the docstring explains. Faithful.
